stories.headline: Broncos beat Seahawks 17-14 in overtime on Wil Lutz's 53-yard field goal
stories.summary:
Ja'Quan McMillian intercepted Seattle quarterback Sam Darnold in overtime Thursday night, setting up Wil Lutz's 53-yard walk-off field goal in a 17-14 Denver win over the defending Super Bowl champion Seahawks. The Broncos defense played without All-Pros Pat Surtain II and Talanoa Hufanga, and starting cornerback Riley Moss (ribs) saw only limited snaps.

Denver ran the ball on 15 of its first 28 offensive snaps and scored on a short J.K. Dobbins run capping a 16-play, 74-yard drive, and on a direct snap to RJ Harvey after a 79-yard march. The defense sacked Darnold twice on the opening drive, forced a fumble, and held Seattle to 159 total yards through three quarters. Reserve cornerbacks Jahdae Barron and Kris Abrams-Draine supplied high-quality play.

The offense struggled after its two touchdown drives. Head coach Sean Payton took over play-calling from Davis Webb after four games, and the team still has trouble running consistently, while quarterback Bo Nix has not looked comfortable for much of the season.

Denver improves to 4-2 after a six-game opening stretch that included Kansas City and five teams that made last year's playoffs. The Broncos have 10 days of rest before traveling to Arizona on Oct. 25.

stories.headline: Avalanche name Brett McLean assistant coach, replacing Dave Hakstol
stories.summary:
The Colorado Avalanche announced that Brett McLean has been named assistant coach, replacing Dave Hakstol, who accepted the head coaching job with the NCAA's Arizona State men's hockey program. McLean joins Nolan Pratt, goaltending coach Jussi Parkkila and assistant/video coach Brett Heimlich on Jared Bednar's staff.

McLean, 48, was most recently an assistant with the Vancouver Canucks in 2025-26, where he ran the power play, which operated at a 21.8% success rate. He previously spent eight seasons in the Minnesota Wild organization, including two as head coach of the AHL's Iowa Wild, and was a Wild assistant from 2020-21 to 2022-23, when the team made the playoffs all three years. He is a former Avalanche player.

General manager Joe Sakic said McLean is familiar with the culture in Colorado and noted that the circumstances are unusual for a staff change so early in a season. McLean said he is eager to rejoin the organization and get acclimated quickly.

stories.headline: Denver mayor, police chief and district attorney decline to back Prop 132 on fentanyl penalties
stories.summary:
Denver Mayor Mike Johnston, the police chief and the district attorney said they do not support Proposition 132, which would increase penalties for fentanyl crimes. The statements came as Colorado voters prepare to decide the measure in the Nov. 3 election.

The officials spoke while announcing the results of Operation Overdose Intercept, a 10-week initiative led by the Denver Police Department, the Drug Enforcement Administration's Rocky Mountain Division and the Denver District Attorney's Office. The operation included 112 sting operations and resulted in 107 arrests, 223 pounds of illegal drugs seized, including 133 pounds of fentanyl, and 23 guns confiscated.

The drugs seized also included methamphetamine and cocaine. Authorities announced the results Thursday as Colorado continues its response to the deadly opioid epidemic.

stories.headline: Griswold and Allen spar in attorney general debate over federal interference and voting rights
stories.summary:
Democratic Secretary of State Jena Griswold and Republican prosecutor Michael Allen held a testy debate three weeks before the Nov. 3 election, each portraying the other as unfit to be Colorado's next attorney general.

Griswold promised to continue efforts to defend Colorado from interference by the federal government, and said the state has seen the largest attack on voting rights in recent history. Allen declined to offer specific opinions on cases brought by current Democratic Attorney General Phil Weiser.

Allen did agree with Weiser's premise that it was against the law for the Trump administration to withhold state and local funds for political reasons. The race will decide who succeeds Weiser as the state's top legal officer.

stories.headline: First freeze of the season expected tonight for Denver and the Plains
stories.summary:
The first freeze of the season is expected tonight across most of the Plains, the Denver metro area and the I-25 corridor. Temperatures are forecast to fall into the mid to upper 20s on the Plains and the upper 20s to lower 30s around Denver. Forecasters advise protecting plants and bringing pets indoors.

Friday will be sunny but chilly, with highs in the upper 50s to near 60 across the Plains. Another cold night is expected Friday, with mid to upper 20s in many low-lying areas and a freeze north and east of the Denver metro area.

Warmer weather returns this weekend, with highs in the 70s on the Plains Saturday and Sunday and mostly dry conditions. Warm weather should continue through the middle of next week. A storm system could arrive late next week, bringing a better chance of showers and mountain snow, with the heaviest precipitation most likely across the northern mountains, though the storm track could still change.

stories.headline: Denver ranks second nationally in Bluevine small business study
stories.summary:
A Bluevine study ranked Colorado Springs first and Denver second in the nation for small business momentum. The results challenge recent criticism of the state's business environment.

Urbanist Richard Florida has argued that Denver's downtown has stronger fundamentals than national headlines suggest. He released a report with recommendations for revitalizing the downtown core.

The ranking arrives amid ongoing debate over Colorado's business climate.

stories.headline: Highlands Ranch-based UDR names Blackstone executive Scott McCallum chief investment officer
stories.summary:
Scott McCallum has joined Highlands Ranch-based UDR Inc. as chief investment officer. He brings a decade of real estate experience from Blackstone.

UDR is a Denver-area real estate investor focused on apartment communities. The hire fills a key leadership role overseeing the company's investment strategy.

The appointment was reported by the Denver Business Journal.

stories.headline: Park & Co burger joint in Uptown Denver closing after 16 years
stories.summary:
Park & Co, a bar and burger restaurant at 439 E. 17th Ave. in Denver's Uptown, will close after serving its last burgers and beers on Sunday, Oct. 19, according to its owner, the Gastamo Group. The restaurant opened in 2010.

Park & Co grew out of restaurateur Jean-Philippe Failyau's success with the Park Burger mini-chain and became part of the basis for the Gastamo Group, which also owns Homegrown Tap & Dough, Perdida and Lady Nomada. Those brands have expanded to larger locations in Westminster, Parker and Central Park.

Gastamo recently closed a Park Burger on West 32nd Avenue. Two other Park Burgers remain, in Platt Park and Hilltop. The group thanked customers and invited them to visit its other Denver restaurants.

stories.headline: Things to do in Denver: Populus music series, DMNS mythic creatures exhibit and comedy tapings
stories.summary:
The Populus hotel in Denver is hosting The Groove Lab, a free Friday-night listening series running Oct. 16 through Nov. 20 from 6 to 8 p.m. It launches with namebackwards + Friends and features a specialty bar and small-plates menu from the hotel's Pasque restaurant. RSVPs are encouraged at opentable.com.

The Denver Museum of Nature & Science opens "Mythic Creatures: Dragons, Unicorns and Mermaids" on Oct. 16, running through April 4, 2027. It includes a 120-foot Chinese parade dragon and life-sized models of a dragon, unicorn, Roc and kraken. It is included with admission of $28 for adults and $21 for ages 3-18.

Comedian Craig Ferguson will tape a special at the Boulder Theater on Saturday, Oct. 17, with shows at 6 and 8:30 p.m. Tom Papa tapes his special at the Paramount Theatre on Oct. 24. Golden's Stories Worth Telling film festival runs Oct. 16-18 with 20 films, filmmaker conversations and panels.
